_README: Adjudication of UNTYPED gear-planner affixes that look like real worn-gear magnitude stats (#227). The candidate rule in src/untyped_rankable.py is 'untyped + numeric + >= 2 distinct items + well-formed + reaches a worn slot'. A candidate in NEITHER list fails the build, so a new untyped worn stat is a reviewed event rather than a silent omission. Only 'allow' names enter metadata.rankable_affixes; 'quarantined' names stay out of the picker suggestions but remain free-typeable via the known set, exactly as before.
_discipline: exclude-until-verified. Add to 'allow' ONLY with wiki evidence that the name is a real, rankable magnitude a player would want to prioritise. 'unreviewed' is an honest reason and marks the filed backlog; it is not a judgement that the name is noise. An empty 'allow' list reproduces the pre-feature rankable vocabulary exactly.
_why_untyped_is_skipped_by_default: Of 183 distinct untyped names across ~5,400 raw item affixes, the population is dominated by weapon procs and banes (Holy on 197 items, Chilling 191, Vampirism 161, Maiming 157, the Bane family). rankable_affixes() skips untyped affixes for that reason and keeps doing so; this file is the narrow, evidenced exception.

allow.name: Enhanced Ki
allow.evidence: The Enhanced Ki page describes an enchantment that increases the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack. It is a magnitude (values 1-5 across the roster), not a proc, and it appears on boots, goggles, necklaces, bracers, armor, and trinkets - never on a weapon alone.
allow.reason: Reported by a player who could not find it in the priority picker (#227). Reaches the picker under its wiki name via affix_name_corrections.json.

quarantined.name: Upgradeable - Tier
quarantined.reason: no page at ddowiki.com/page/Upgradeable_-_Tier (404). It is also typed on other items, so the untyped instances remain a likely upstream parse gap rather than a stat.

quarantined.name: Linguistics
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'reduced the cooldowns of your Social skills (Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate) by 10%.' A cooldown reduction, not a stat the solver can sum or rank.

quarantined.name: Tendon Slice
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'gives a X% chance to Hamstring the target for each attack that does damage.' A proc rate, not a worn magnitude. Valuing it needs #331.

quarantined.name: Spearblock
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'Reduces physical damage taken by (X), except from Bludgeoning or Slashing weapons. (Damage Reduction: (X)/Slash, Bludgeon)'. A real worn magnitude, but qualified Damage Reduction is not a rankable concept here — `Damage Reduction` is not in CORE_STATS and the solver models PRR/MRR instead. Admitting it would mint a stat family the solver has no notion of.

quarantined.name: Arcane Casting Dexterity
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'reduces the arcane spell failure chance by -5%.' Arcane spell failure is not a tracked stat, and the wiki states a fixed -5% while the catalog carries values 5/10/15 — so the stored number does not mean what the name suggests either.

quarantined.name: Axeblock
quarantined.reason: wiki: the same qualified Damage Reduction shape as Spearblock (except Bludgeoning or Piercing). Same verdict.

quarantined.name: Arcane Augmentation
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'increases your effective caster level for specific spells by the listed level... determined on a spell-by-spell basis.' Conditional and spell-specific, which is #214's class — a flat constant would misstate it.

quarantined.name: Smite Evil Charges
quarantined.reason: no page at ddowiki.com/page/Smite_Evil_Charges (404); nothing to verify against.

quarantined.name: Lesser Arcane Augmentation
quarantined.reason: same Spell Augmentation page and the same spell-by-spell conditionality as Arcane Augmentation. #214.

quarantined.name: Illusory Death
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'Increases your caster level when casting Illusion and Necromancy spells by x.' A real magnitude, but conditional on the school cast — #214's class, and it is stored type `None` rather than untyped.

quarantined.name: Raging Strength
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'Your Rage abilities grant an additional +X Strength.' Held only while raging, and only by a character with Rage. #214's class.

quarantined.name: Divine Augmentation
quarantined.reason: same Spell Augmentation page and the same spell-by-spell conditionality as Arcane Augmentation. #214.

quarantined.name: Deception
quarantined.reason: wiki: '+X (type) bonus to hit and +Y to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack' — it CARRIES a type. The catalog bears that out: 187 instances typed Bool/Enhancement/Insight/Quality and only a handful untyped, so the untyped ones are an upstream parse gap, not an untyped stat.

quarantined.name: Hammerblock
quarantined.reason: wiki: the same qualified Damage Reduction shape as Spearblock (except Piercing or Slashing). Same verdict.

quarantined.name: Improved Fire Augmentation
quarantined.reason: no page at ddowiki.com/page/Improved_Fire_Augmentation (404); nothing to verify against.

quarantined.name: Burning Glory
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'On Harmful Spellcast: Do an additional X to (6*X) Fire Damage... Cooldown: 1 second.' An on-cast proc. Needs #331.

quarantined.name: Distant Incite
quarantined.reason: wiki: '+X% Enhancement bonus to increased threat generation from ranged damage' — stated as an Enhancement bonus, so the untyped instances are an upstream parse gap.

quarantined.name: Ice Guard
quarantined.reason: wiki (Elemental Guard): damage to an attacker on a successful melee attack against the wearer. An on-hit proc. Needs #331.

quarantined.name: Lesser Divine Augmentation
quarantined.reason: no page at ddowiki.com/page/Lesser_Divine_Augmentation (404); nothing to verify against.

quarantined.name: Lesser Evocation Augmentation
quarantined.reason: no page at ddowiki.com/page/Lesser_Evocation_Augmentation (404); nothing to verify against.

quarantined.name: Radiant Glory
quarantined.reason: wiki: 'On Harmful Spellcast: Do an additional 2 to 12 Light Damage... Cooldown 1 second.' An on-cast proc. Needs #331.

quarantined.name: Thorn Guard
quarantined.reason: wiki: '1d8 piercing damage on a successful melee attack' against the wearer. An on-hit proc. Needs #331. Also typed elsewhere, so the untyped instances may additionally be a parse gap.

_adjudication_2026_08_29.verdict: All 22 reviewed against the DDO Wiki. NONE is admitted to the picker.
_adjudication_2026_08_29.why_none: The candidate rule finds untyped affixes that LOOK like worn magnitudes. Reading each page shows every one is something else: a proc, a conditional or spell-specific effect, a real magnitude for a concept this app does not rank (qualified Damage Reduction), an upstream parse gap on an affix that is typed elsewhere, or a page that does not exist. That is a result, not an absence of one — the queue no longer carries 22 names whose status nobody had checked.
_adjudication_2026_08_29.revisit_when: A proc verdict changes if #331 ships proc valuation. A conditional verdict changes if #214 gives the pipeline a way to tell a conditional from a constant. A parse-gap verdict changes on a gear-planner refresh that types the remaining instances — which is exactly how the 21 names retired on 2026-08-18 resolved.
